description: This file contains tests for helper functions used in a Telegram bot extension, including message handling, forwarding context normalization, and channel/thread resolution.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumThreadId
methods.description: Resolves the forum thread ID based on message context parameters, returning undefined if not applicable.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Determines whether a chat is a forum (threaded) in Telegram, optionally fetching chat info.

methods.name: buildTelegramThreadParams
methods.description: Builds parameters for Telegram API calls based on thread ID and scope.

methods.name: buildTelegramRoutingTarget
methods.description: Constructs a routing target string for Telegram based on chat ID and thread info.

methods.name: buildTypingThreadParams
methods.description: Creates thread parameters for typing indicator commands.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDirectPeerId
methods.description: Resolves the peer ID for direct communication, preferring sender ID when available.

methods.name: normalizeForwardedContext
methods.description: Normalizes various forward_origin message formats into a unified forwarded context object.

methods.name: describeReplyTarget
methods.description: Analyzes a message's reply_to_message to extract reply, forwarded, or external reply context, handling various formats.

methods.name: hasBotMention
methods.description: Checks if a message text mentions the bot explicitly by username or mention entity.

methods.name: expandTextLinks
methods.description: Replaces text_link entities in message text with markdown links.
